title: GNSS: add dissectors for SBAS L1 navigation messages
description:
Add dissectors for navigation messages of the Satellite-based
Augmentation System (on L1 frequency). Includes dissectors for message
types MT1, MT2 - MT6, and MT25.

the ubx part is the same like !10405 ?

it is not possible to have only SBAS

The SBAS commit builds upon the UBX one (due to the handoff from UBX-RXM-SFRBX dissection to SBAS dissection).
Of course, in principle, other messages than UBX ones may include SBAS navigation messages.
For example, I am working on an EMS dissector and will add a handoff from EMS to SBAS.
